subject: english
stem: Post: 'Our team planted 100 trees. Help us water them this month.' How does the first sentence serve the purpose?
options: It changes the post into a weather report.
It shows existing progress before asking for help.
It proves every tree will survive.
It asks readers to cut the trees.

optionRationales.reason: It changes the post into a weather report.：不是。
It shows existing progress before asking for help.：先展示成果，再號召 watering。
It proves every tree will survive.：仍需澆水且過度。
It asks readers to cut the trees.：相反。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「選擇性資訊、行動號召與情緒語言揭示廣告或社群貼文希望讀者採取的行動」可推出 It shows existing progress before asking for help.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 It shows existing progress before asking for help. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
